note: Frames carry no biggerStudy field in format.ts (FrameSchema is strict); each committee frame's bigger study is in its note as 'biggerStudy: ...' until the field exists (requested).

lists.title: Hats
lists.note: Grammar: one hat, with 'a', lower case, at most 19 characters; reads after 'wearing', 'in', 'with' and before 'each'. Every phrase fits the town and every office.

lists.title: Places a sign can stand by
lists.note: Grammar: a spot that reads after 'by', with 'the', lower case, at most 20 characters; spots any town has (no canal, jetty, motorway or lighthouse), so the list serves 'any' frames as well as the given governor frame.

lists.title: Harmless complaints
lists.note: Grammar: a complaint as it follows 'says', 'that', 'whether' or a colon, lower case, no full stop, no person named, at most 23 characters; about a thing, never about a person or a group.

lists.title: Odd units of distance
lists.note: Grammar: an amount in odd units, a number word or 'a' then things, lower case, at most 19 characters; reads after 'by' and 'in', before 'back', 'higher', 'along', 'nearer', 'of high street' and 'of silence'.

lists.title: Things to rename
lists.note: Grammar: one thing any town has, with 'the', lower case, at most 22 characters; reads after 'rename', 'name', 'for' and 'pad'. No duck pond (mayor-2's), no lost property (the any-office batch's).
